page_title: Personal AI on Hardware You Already Own

summary.name: Off Grid AI
summary.one_liner: A personal AI assistant that runs on hardware you already own, covering memory, meetings, clipboard, passwords and offline image and model use across several platforms.
use_cases: Chat with an AI model privately without sending data to the cloud
Transcribe meetings on your Mac without a call bot
Keep a searchable clipboard history across apps
Store encrypted passwords, keys and notes
Track time spent by app, project and person
Use local models offline on a phone or laptop
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI assistant that keeps memory, meetings, notes and files on the user's own devices. It says meetings are transcribed on the Mac with no bot joining calls, and that screen content can be read and summarized locally with capture pausable at any time. Devices sync device to device with encryption and no Off Grid AI server in between, and answers show their sources. Actions such as sending or handling tasks require the user's approval. It also lists a clipboard history, an encrypted vault for passwords and keys, dictation and voice answers, and an OpenAI-compatible API served from the user's machine.
notable: Device-to-device encrypted sync with no Off Grid AI server in between
Meetings transcribed on the Mac with no bot joining the call
OpenAI-compatible API running on your own machine for other apps
Downloadable models work with Wi-Fi off
caveats: Pro is a paid tier (lifetime or monthly); the free tier is described as free but limits are not fully listed
Pro lifetime price shown with a limited-time discount; exact current price not confirmed in page text
Sync and some features are tied to Pro or device limits (5 devices listed under Pro)
